title: Generative AI designs functional thiolation domains for reprogramming non-ribosomal peptide synthetases.
authors: Bulbul, Emre F; Bang, Seounggun; George, Kevin; Bianchi, Gabriele; Raj, Prateek; Chung, Seonyong; Pauline, Vincent; Hochstrasser, Ramon; Minas, Hannah A; Elgaher, Walid A M; Kany, Andreas M; Hirsch, Anna K H; Schmitt, Steven; Heinz, Dirk W; Kalinina, Olga V; Klakow, Dietrich; Bozhuyuk, Kenan A J
one_liner_zh: 该文利用生成式AI（ESM3、ProteinMPNN、EvoDiff）设计NRPS硫醇化结构域，结合MD模拟验证结构稳定性与域间接触网络，直接命中蛋白质结构设计、序列设计与计算模拟核心问题，方法创新且对象为蛋白质结构相关。
abstract: Large language models and generative protein design promise to accelerate biotechnology, but it remains unclear whether they can engineer dynamic megasynth(et)ases whose activity depends on transient, context-specific domain interfaces. Non-ribosomal peptide synthetases (NRPSs) exemplify this challenge and produce many clinically used therapeutics. Here we integrate pretrained generative models (ESM3, ProteinMPNN and EvoDiff) with design-build-test-learn cycles and data-guided prioritization to generate 76 de novo thiolation (T) domains. We build and test 578 recombinant NRPS variants in vivo spanning minimal, full-length, and hybrid assembly lines. AI-designed T-domains support product formation across architectures, enable catalytically active hybrids at recombined junctions, and increase yields by up to ~3-fold relative to NRPSs carrying the native T-domain. A representative design shows improved soluble expression, refolding, and a 12  degrees C higher melting temperature, while molecular dynamics simulations indicate preserved global stability but reshaped, state-dependent interdomain contact networks. Together, these results establish generative design as an effective route to context-conditioned engineering and reprogramming of biosynthetic assembly lines.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型与生成式蛋白质设计有望加速生物技术的发展，但其是否能够工程化改造活性依赖于瞬时、情境特异性结构域界面的动态巨型合成（酶）仍不明确。非核糖体肽合成酶（NRPSs）体现了这一挑战，并生产多种临床使用的治疗药物。在此，我们将预训练生成模型（ESM3、ProteinMPNN和EvoDiff）与设计-构建-测试-学习循环及数据引导的优先级排序相结合，生成了76个从头设计的硫醇化（T）结构域。我们在体内构建并测试了578个重组NRPS变体，涵盖最小型、全长型和杂交型组装线。AI设计的T结构域支持跨架构的产物形成，在重组连接处实现具有催化活性的杂交体，并相对于携带天然T结构域的NRPSs将产量提高至约3倍。一个代表性设计显示出改善的可溶性表达、复性能力以及高出12摄氏度的熔解温度，而分子动力学模拟表明其保持了整体稳定性，但重塑了状态依赖的结构域间接触网络。综合来看，这些结果确立了生成式设计作为情境条件化工程和生物合成组装线重编程的有效途径。
